body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> LG electronics reinforces commitment to plasma HDTVs with slim, versatile design, picture-enhancing technology at the International CES 2010.

LG Electronics underscored its commitment to the plasma HDTV category with eight new models for 2010, led by the new LG INFINIA series, which represents the best in LG's design, technology and entertainment options.
Featuring new picture-enhancing technology and lightweight designs in a variety of screen sizes, four new plasma series 'PK950' and 'PK750', as well as the 'PK550' and 'PJ350'.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
